stage: Retrospective revision-stage lock before the three new cohort effects. Historical HNSCC results already known.
source_location: Materials and Methods > Define C1QC+ TAMs, SPP1+ TAMs, and M1/M2 Gene Signatures, first paragraph (explicit exhaustive SPP1+ TAM list).
source_scoring: Li et al. used Seurat v3.2.2 AddModuleScore for single-cell data and an arithmetic mean for cervical bulk RNA. Our scoring procedure must be described as an adaptation.
source_note: Li et al. explicitly attribute the marker signatures to Zhang et al. GSE146771. The exact ordered 15-gene enumeration is verified directly from Li et al.
gene_selection: Complete published list, no ranking or trimming in the target cohorts. No anchor overlap.
axis_rule: Use all 15 genes and LILRB4; a symbol absent from the deposited gene axis makes that input unsupported. Within a sparse per-sample matrix a known zero on a documented common gene axis needs separate treatment from an unmeasured gene. Do not silently drop symbols or reselect a signature based on results.
interpretation: Expression signature of a macrophage state associated with angiogenic and extracellular-matrix-related features. It does not measure physical matrix remodeling, therapeutic response, or a marker-defined proportion of cells.
